name: Cookie Information
description: Integration cookie consent popup from Cookieinformation.com.
project_description:
Cookie information integration for Drupal to allow end-users to control their cookie tracking.

 Back to top 

 Overview 
 The Cookie information module allows the administrator to insert an automatically generated cookie banner and preference centre script to their website. Cookie information uses the domain to recognize the correct cookie banner. The implementation of the module is very lightweight and straightforward to do.

 Back to top 

 Getting started 
 Sign up for a Cookie information account to register your site for the service.

 Visit cookieinformation.com to get started.

 After registering your site to Cookie information, you can install and configure the module to setup the cookie banner.

 Back to top 

 How it works 
 
 Register your site for Cookie information. 
 Configure your domains and sites to be scanned by Cookie information. 
 Install the Drupal module and enable the Cookie popup to allow Cookie information to scan your site. 
 Style and configure your banner and preference in the Consent management center. 
 Allows blocking of third-party cookies when embedded through a tag manager like Google Tag Manager 
 
 Back to top 

 Feature highlights 
 Cookie information is a mature and trusted cookie consent tool that is purpose-built for compliance with GDPR and IAB framework.

 
 Collects and securely stores cookie consents 
 Customizable to fit your brand and website design 
 Easy to implement with your CMS and tag manager 
 Enables your compliance with international privacy laws like GDPR and CCPA 
 +42 languages so you can localize your consent collection 
 Connects with a range of services like Shopify, Google products and more 
 
 Find more about Cookie information features .

 Back to top 

 Get help 
 See detailed instructions and support information in the Cookie information knowledge base .

 If you have any questions or issues with the module, you can create an issue in the module issue queue or contact any of the maintainers for more information. 

 For questions related to the actual service and help in using it, you can contact Cookie information for help .

 Back to top 

 Disclaimer 
 This module allows you to publish Cookie information’s cookie banner and preference centre on your Drupal website. Use of this module does not, by itself, ensure compliance with legal requirements related to cookies.

 This module is officially supported by Cookie information . The support provided to this module is only related to the Drupal integration. Any support or help request on actually implementing the service to your website should be sent to Cookie information through their website.

 Back to top 

 About 
 This module was created by FFW and supported by Exove . Cookie information has provided support for the built-in tools and supports the module development.
